description: Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel University of Agriculture & Technology is a state agricultural university at Modipuram, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, established in 2000 and inaugurated in 2002, with constituent colleges in agriculture, biotechnology, veterinary and animal science, technology, horticulture, post-harvest and food processing, and sugarcane science and technology.
